definitions: Situations or examples that lie at the extremes or edges of a defined set, category, or rule, often testing its limits or applicability.
Unusual or atypical instances that challenge the general understanding or typical behavior of a system or concept.
examples: The software testing team focused on boundary cases to ensure robustness.
Legal scholars often debate boundary cases to clarify the scope of a law.
Identifying boundary cases is crucial for comprehensive problem-solving.
